question: How do I replace the tub bearing in my washing machine?
answer: To replace the washing machine tub bearing, first disconnect the power and water supply. Next, remove the access panel and take out the old bearing. Then, install the new bearing and reassemble the tub. Finally, reconnect the power and water supply.
steps: Disconnect the power and water supply to the washing machine.
Remove the access panel to the tub.
Take out the old tub bearing.
Reassemble the tub and reconnect the access panel.
Reconnect the power and water supply to the washing machine.
safety_info: Electrical shock hazard - ensure the power is disconnected before starting work. Water damage hazard - contain the water supply lines to prevent leaks.
tips: Use a tub removal tool to avoid damaging the tub.
Apply lubricant to the new bearing to ensure smooth operation.
